description: This file implements decryption functionalities for various symmetric encryption algorithms used in TLS, including functions for different cipher algorithms such as RC4, DES, 3DES, IDEA, AES, RC2, and a general decrypt function which dispatches based on cipher algorithm. It is part of the TLS Crypto Provider module, responsible for cryptographic operations related to TLS protocol.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoDecrypt(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG cipher_algorithm,ANSC_CRYPTO_KEY * i_key,ANSC_CRYPTO_IV * i_iv,void * i_data,ULONG i_data_size,void * o_data,PULONG o_data_size)
methods.description: Performs decryption using specified cipher algorithm; dispatches to specific decryption function based on cipher_algorithm.
